description: This file defines a Java interface 'SmsCampaignReadPlatformService' that provides methods for retrieving SMS campaign data and templates within the system.

classes.name: SmsCampaignReadPlatformService
classes.description: A Java interface for read operations related to SMS campaigns.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single SMS campaign by its ID.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all SMS campaigns based on search parameters.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves an SMS template based on the report type.
